description: This file implements back-end APIs for the COSA Data Model Library related to Neighbor Discovery, including creation, initialization, registration, and removal of neighbor discovery interfaces and their related access to a persistent registry.

classes.name: COSA_DATAMODEL_NEIGHDISC
classes.description: Data model class for neighbor discovery, containing configuration, list management, and registry folder handles.

classes.name: COSA_DML_NEIGHDISC_IF_FULL
classes.description: Represents a full data structure for neighbor discovery interface, including configuration and instance info.

classes.name: COSA_CONTEXT_LINK_OBJECT
classes.description: Context object for linking configuration entries within lists, including instance number, context handles, and flags.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaNeighdiscCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new neighbor discovery data model object, including setting function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaNeighdiscInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the neighbor discovery data model, sets up registry folders, loads existing interface entries, and performs registration.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaNeighdiscRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes and frees resources associated with the neighbor discovery data model, including list cleanup and folder deletion.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaNeighdiscRegGetInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves neighbor discovery interface information from the registry into internal data structures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaNeighdiscRegAddInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Registers new neighbor discovery interface information into the registry, creating folders and records as needed.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaNeighdiscRegDelInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Deletes specific neighbor discovery interface information from the registry.

ctags.name: CosaNeighdiscRegAddInfo
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
